text.arabic_uthmani: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ

words.gloss_range: opening conjunction with resumptive and coordinating force, binding this diagnosis to the prior proof discourse
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a boundary connector: it can resume a new diagnosis while still coordinating with the preceding proof discourse. Because it is immediately followed by {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}), the reader hears connection and negation together, so the verse starts as a restricted historical claim rather than as a detached topic change. The connector therefore turns the completed description of 98:3 into the hinge for the report of division in 98:4.

topics.headline: opening connector marks continuity and new diagnosis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah is neither detached from 98:3 nor swallowed by it; the connector makes a marked transition into diagnosis.
topics.reason: QAC identifies {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) as an introductory or coordinating conjunction, and the main clause begins a new restricted predicate.

topics.headline: connector enters the restriction frame immediately
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the ayah enter connection and negation at once, before the later exception completes the restriction.
topics.reason: Attachment support marks the full {{ar:مَا ... إِلَّا}} ({{tr:mā ... illā}}) restriction over the predicate, so the opening connector belongs to that bound frame.

words.gloss_range: negative particle denying the completed division until the exception phrase restricts the timing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: negated division completed by an exception

words.prose: This first {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is the negator, not the later subordinating particle. It denies the completed occurrence of {{ar:تَفَرَّقَ}} ({{tr:tafarraqa}}) before the exception arrives, forcing the reader to wait for {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) to learn the sole allowed timing. The result is not a loose emphasis but a bound restriction: division is held in suspension until the proof-arrival phrase names the after-point.

topics.headline: negative particle denies the completed division
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first beat denies division as a completed historical occurrence before it identifies the exception.
topics.reason: QAC marks word 2 as a negative particle governing the perfect verb {{ar:تَفَرَّقَ}} ({{tr:tafarraqa}}).

topics.headline: negation supplies the first half of the exception frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah's architecture: the negation blocks every candidate timing until the exception phrase allows only one.
topics.reason: Attachment translation support explicitly requires preserving the {{ar:مَا ... إِلَّا}} ({{tr:mā ... illā}}) restriction.

words.gloss_range: Form V intransitive/reflexive social fragmentation, negated until the after-proof exception
words.root_gloss_range: separating, cleaving, distinguishing, factional grouping, and criterion-making are present in the wider root family; the local Form V verb selects mutual self-fragmentation

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the clear proof that arrives as the temporal trigger

words.prose: {{ar:تَفَرَّقَ}} ({{tr:tafarraqa}}) names the fracture itself before the subject is fully identified, but the negation keeps that fracture from occurring until the exception phrase. Its Form V, intransitive shape makes the community itself the site of splitting, not an external object of dispute. The wider {{ar:ف ر ق}} ({{tr:f-r-q}}) field can distinguish as well as divide; here that root pressure becomes pointed because division happens only after the clarifying {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}). The echo with division-after-clarification passages (3:105; 42:14) sharpens the warning without overriding the local grammar. Even the marked verbal choice and tightened sound texture make the event feel sharper than a neutral faction label.

topics.headline: Form V makes division reciprocal and internal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the division as internal self-fracture by the group, not as a passive split caused by an outside agent.
topics.reason: QAC gives Form V perfect verb, and attachment/valency show an intransitive frame with no expressed object.

topics.headline: the action appears before the delayed subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader encounters the denied action first and then learns who is implicated, which turns the subject phrase into a delayed identification.
topics.reason: The verb precedes {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}), and QAC explains the standard pre-subject singular agreement.

topics.headline: distinction root pressure turns into social division
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the paradox that a root family associated with separating and criterion-making is used for destructive communal fragmentation after clarifying proof.
topics.reason: The local sense remains Form V division; broader criterion and separating branches survive as root-field pressure, not as alternate local meanings.

topics.headline: division after clarification echoes warning passages
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that 98:4 participates in a known warning pattern where division follows knowledge or proof, especially 3:105 and 42:14.
topics.reason: The row gives concrete parallels (3:105; 42:14), and the local syntax also restricts division to after arrival of the proof.

topics.headline: rare local form and sound sharpen the fracture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear and notice the marked verbal event as sharper than a neutral faction label.
topics.reason: The contextual profile marks this exact root-form as low occurrence, and the sound rows remain tied to the actual local surface.

words.gloss_range: definite plural relative pronoun that identifies the subject through the following passive-reception clause
words.prose: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) delays the identity of the subject until after the denied division has been heard. It does not name the group independently; it forces their identity through the clause {{ar:أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:ūtū al-kitāba}}), so the ones implicated are defined by received scripture before the ayah turns to the exception. That makes the critique precise: division is attached to those whose status was formed by being given the Book.

topics.headline: relative pronoun defines the dividers by received scripture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the subject is identified through reception of scripture, not through a neutral group label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes {{ar:أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:ūtū al-kitāba}}) the relative clause identifying {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}).

topics.headline: complex subject arrives after the main verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first hears the denied action and then receives the identity of the actors as a built relative phrase.
topics.reason: {{ar:الَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) is the explicit subject of the preceding verb, and the subject phrase is completed before the exception.

words.gloss_range: perfect Form IV passive reception: were given or caused to receive, with the Book as explicit object
words.root_gloss_range: coming, reaching, bringing, giving, and causing-to-come form the wider family; the local Form IV passive selects being given while preserving arrival-to-recipients pressure
words.prose: {{ar:أُوتُوا}} ({{tr:ūtū}}) defines the subject by completed passive reception: the giver is suppressed, but the recipients and what they received stay in view. The Form IV passive means the Book was made to reach them, so the wider {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) coming/giving field is narrowed to being given while still preparing the later arrival verb {{ar:جَاءَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾathumu}}). The ayah then contrasts roles: they are recipients in the relative clause, but actors in the division. Within the surah's thread, active coming in 98:1, passive receipt here, and giving obligation in 98:5 turn received status into accountable response, while the long vowel lets that passive-reception status linger before the Book is named.

topics.headline: passive reception defines the group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the group defined by a completed gift received before their later response is judged.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect passive Form IV verb, and attachment makes it the predicate of the relative clause.

topics.headline: caused-arrival pressure survives inside giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears giving as something made to reach the recipients, while the explicit object keeps the local sense on being given the Book.
topics.reason: The local object {{ar:الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:al-kitāba}}) selects the giving sense; the wider coming branch remains image-pressure rather than replacing it.

topics.headline: recipients become responsible actors
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the moral shift from a group receiving scripture to the same group actively dividing.
topics.reason: The relative clause casts them as passive recipients, while the main verb assigns the division to the same subject.

topics.headline: given-the-Book formula joins the surah's arrival thread
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a recognized scripture-recipient formula linked to the surah's repeated movement of coming, receiving, and obligation.
topics.reason: The contextual data supports {{ar:أ ت ي}} ({{tr:ʾ-t-y}}) with Book collocation, and the CRITICAL rows give same-surah links to 98:1 and 98:5.

topics.headline: the prolonged passive form gives received status weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the passive-reception status linger before the object is named.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the actual local surface and supports, rather than replaces, the passive-reception topic.

words.gloss_range: definite singular Book as the explicit object received, functioning as known institutional scripture
words.root_gloss_range: writing, recording, binding or joining written matter, prescribing, and fixed decree belong to the wider family; the local noun selects scripture as received written authority
words.prose: {{ar:الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:al-kitāba}}) is the explicit object retained under the passive: even when the giver is not named, the thing transmitted is grammatically present. Its definiteness and singular form make the received object a known scriptural body, not generic writing, shifting from the plural writings of 98:3 into the scripture-receiving identity of the people who divide. The broader {{ar:ك ت ب}} ({{tr:k-t-b}}) field of writing, binding, and prescribing is narrowed here to received scripture, but that range lets the Book feel like fixed authority, so division after receiving it becomes especially charged. The firm stop-consonant texture reinforces that fixed-authority feel without changing the local sense.

topics.headline: the Book remains the explicit object of passive reception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees exactly what defined the recipients: the Book remains explicit even though the giver is suppressed.
topics.reason: Attachment marks {{ar:الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:al-kitāba}}) as the retained accusative object of {{ar:أُوتُوا}} ({{tr:ūtū}}).

topics.headline: definite singular scripture gathers the received authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from plural writings in 98:3 to a definite singular Book defining a historical community.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite singular, and the CRITICAL rows give the same-surah contrast with 98:3.

topics.headline: writing and prescription pressure load the scripture noun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the Book as written and binding authority, while the local noun remains scripture rather than an abstract decree.
topics.reason: V4 preserves writing, joining, and prescription branches, but the local definite object selects scripture as the active sense.

topics.headline: Book vocabulary turns contents into social identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the movement from the contents of proof to the scripture-receiving identity of the people who divide.
topics.reason: The phrase belongs to the subject-defining relative clause, and the CRITICAL rows link it to the surah's Book vocabulary.

topics.headline: stop pattern reinforces fixed authority
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the noun's firmness alongside its semantic role as fixed written authority.
topics.reason: The sound observation is tied to the local surface and reinforces the retained-authority reading.

words.gloss_range: exception particle completing the negation into an only-after restriction

supporting_anchors.display: {{ar:مَا ... إِلَّا مِنْ بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:mā ... illā min baʿdi}})

words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge where the denied main beat turns into the only permitted exception. After the opening negation, it does not merely add an aside; it converts the whole clause into an exclusive timing claim. Everything before it is the denied division, and everything after it names the post-arrival frame from which that division is allowed to begin. That diagnostic restriction also prepares the command restriction that follows in 98:5.

topics.headline: exception completes the restriction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees negation become an only-after claim rather than a simple denial.
topics.reason: QAC marks an exception particle completing the restriction with word 2.

topics.headline: particle divides the ayah into denied premise and sole exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can track the ayah's two-beat architecture around the exception pivot.
topics.reason: Attachment places the after-phrase inside the restricted main predicate rather than as an independent narrative addition.

topics.headline: restriction frame anticipates the next ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the diagnostic restriction of 98:4 prepares the command restriction in 98:5.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah continuation from the 98:4 restriction frame into 98:5.

words.gloss_range: preposition of source/origin governing the following temporal noun and marking the post-proof starting point
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) turns the exception into a source-point in time. Governed with {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}), it does more than say division was later; it marks the post-proof moment as the point from which the division begins. Its tight dependency and nasal link into the following temporal noun make the phrase a compact unit, moving the discourse from timeless description into historical sequence.

topics.headline: source preposition marks the onset of after-time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the after-proof phrase is an origin point for division, not a vague later date.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment mark {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) as governing {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) in the excepted temporal phrase.

topics.headline: short preposition binds into the temporal frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears and sees the compact phrase move the discourse from timeless description into historical sequence.
topics.reason: Attachment makes {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) the governed complement, and the boundary rows tie the phrase to the scene shift.

words.gloss_range: genitive construct temporal noun meaning after, dependent on the following arrival clause
words.root_gloss_range: spatial remoteness, temporal posteriority, distance, and distancing belong to the wider family; the local construct noun selects temporal after-ness with distance pressure

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the arrival of the clear proof to them

words.prose: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is the ayah's temporal hinge. It is governed by {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) and, as a construct noun, depends on the following {{ar:مَا جَاءَتْهُمُ الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:mā jāʾathumu al-bayyinatu}}) clause; the arrival of the proof defines what after means. The wider {{ar:ب ع د}} ({{tr:b-ʿ-d}}) distance field is narrowed to temporal posteriority, but it still makes the aftermath feel like movement away from the earlier state. The repeated after-arrival pattern and short three-word temporal cadence carry the reader quickly from exception into proof-arrival aftermath.

topics.headline: construct after depends on the arrival clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that after is not free-floating; it is measured by the proof's arrival.
topics.reason: Attachment marks the following {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) clause as the complement completing {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}).

topics.headline: genitive after-phrase serves the exception timing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the exception become a precise before-after argument.
topics.reason: {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) is governed by {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) inside the excepted timing phrase.

topics.headline: distance image colors the temporal aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels after-time as a threshold that also suggests relational distance, while the local noun still means temporal after.
topics.reason: The local form is a noun of temporal posteriority, not a verb of distancing; the distance branch survives as pressure.

topics.headline: after-arrival formula makes timing accountable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes an after-arrival pattern specialized here around proof and division.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows preserve the formulaic pattern, and the local syntax confirms the arrival clause as the temporal reference.

topics.headline: short temporal chain carries the scene into aftermath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the phrase carry the ayah quickly from exception into proof-arrival aftermath.
topics.reason: The cadence rows are tied to the actual local chain and support the boundary shift from 98:3 into 98:4.

words.gloss_range: subordinating particle after the temporal noun, allowing event-centered and arrived-thing readings of the arrival clause
words.prose: The second {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) is not the opening negator. It links {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}) to the finite arrival clause, letting the after-phrase depend on the proof's coming. Its surface also allows two local readings: event-focused, after the coming, and object-focused, after what came. Both remain coherent because {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}) is at once the arrived proof and the event-trigger.

topics.headline: particle bridges the temporal noun to the arrival clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the after-phrase built as a clause-dependent temporal construction, not as a loose adverb.
topics.reason: QAC allows maṣdariyyah or mawṣūlah, and attachment marks the clause as the complement of {{ar:بَعْدِ}} ({{tr:baʿdi}}).

topics.headline: same surface keeps event and arrived proof in play
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear both after the coming and after what came without changing the wording.
topics.reason: The guardrail evidence explicitly preserves both licensed parses, while the syntax keeps both under the same restriction.

words.gloss_range: perfect feminine singular arrival verb with attached 3mp object suffix: the proof came to them as a completed event
words.root_gloss_range: coming, arriving, reaching, bringing, and arrival-with-contact dominate the family; the local Form I perfect selects completed arrival to recipients

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the clear proof as postponed subject

words.prose: {{ar:جَاءَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾathumu}}) makes the proof's coming a completed event that reached the same group already identified as recipients of the Book. Its feminine verb agrees with the postponed subject {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}), while the attached suffix makes the arrival targeted to them, so the event and recipients are heard before the proof is finally named. The ayah therefore does not speak of abstract proof in general; it fixes division after the moment when the clear proof came to those recipients. The proof-arrival formula echoes division and dispute passages such as 2:213 and 3:105, and the local contrast with {{ar:أُوتُوا}} ({{tr:ūtū}}) binds received scripture to arrived evidence. The long vowel and glottal catch make the arrival verb stretch and catch before the final proof-name closes the ayah.

topics.headline: perfect arrival fixes the event as completed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proof's coming as a completed fact after which division is dated.
topics.reason: QAC marks a perfect verb, and the contextual profile shows the exact root-form is strongly associated with perfect arrival.

topics.headline: suffix directs the proof's arrival to the named group
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the proof reached the same people who divided, not an unspecified audience.
topics.reason: Attachment resolves the object suffix to the subject group {{ar:الَّذِينَ أُوتُوا الْكِتَابَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna ūtū al-kitāba}}).

topics.headline: feminine agreement makes the proof the mover of arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the arrival event and recipient suffix before the proof is finally named as subject.
topics.reason: Attachment marks {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}) as the feminine subject of the verb.

topics.headline: proof-arrival formula anchors the trigger
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes a formula of proof coming to people as the trigger point for division, with parallels including 2:213 and 3:105.
topics.reason: Collocation data links {{ar:ج ي أ}} ({{tr:j-y-ʾ}}) with {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}), and attachment makes this arrival the temporal anchor of the exception.

topics.headline: arrival verb contrasts with passive giving
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees two transmission moments: the Book was given, and the proof came as an event entering time.
topics.reason: The local ayah uses {{ar:أُوتُوا}} ({{tr:ūtū}}) for passive receipt and {{ar:جَاءَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾathumu}}) for eventive arrival.

topics.headline: sound texture lets arrival land before the proof is named
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the arrival verb stretch and catch before the final proof-name closes the ayah.
topics.reason: The sound rows are tied to the local surface and support the arrival-before-subject syntax.

words.gloss_range: definite singular clear proof, the nominative postponed subject of the arrival verb and known proof from the surah opening
words.root_gloss_range: clarity, making manifest, distinction, separation, being between, and decisive evidence belong to the wider family; the local noun selects manifest proof that distinguishes truth
words.prose: {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}) closes the ayah as the postponed subject of the arrival verb: the proof is what came, and the verse lands on the trigger rather than on the divided group. Its definiteness points back to the known proof introduced in 98:1, now reported as having arrived, so the same proof moves from awaited criterion to received trigger. The wider {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) field joins clarity with distinction, so the word is not a vague sign; it is manifest proof that separates truth from falsehood. That makes the ending sharp: clarifying separation becomes the point after which destructive group-separation occurs. The repeated proof ending binds 98:1 and 98:4 by sound as well as lexeme, and the central doubling gives the final word extra acoustic density.

topics.headline: the clear proof is the subject of arrival
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the proof act by arriving while the people act by dividing.
topics.reason: Attachment marks {{ar:الْبَيِّنَةُ}} ({{tr:al-bayyinatu}}) as the feminine subject of {{ar:جَاءَتْهُمُ}} ({{tr:jāʾathumu}}).

topics.headline: definite proof returns from the surah opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final word is the known proof from 98:1, now shifted from awaited criterion to arrived trigger.
topics.reason: Attachment cross-reference marks the definite noun as resuming the proof frame introduced in 98:1 and elaborated in 98:2-3.

topics.headline: clarity and distinction pressure make the proof decisive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the proof as manifest clarification that distinguishes truth from falsehood, while the local noun remains proof rather than generic separation.
topics.reason: The b-y-n clarity/separation family supports distinguishing pressure, but local grammar selects the definite proof noun.

topics.headline: definite singular proof concentrates the verse ending
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the ayah close on one known proof as the decisive trigger for the restricted after-point.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite singular nominative, and the local word order places it at the verse close.

topics.headline: proof noun completes the arrival formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes the local cluster of Book received, proof arrived, and division after proof.
topics.reason: Contextual profiles show a strong {{ar:ب ي ن}} ({{tr:b-y-n}}) and {{ar:ج ي أ}} ({{tr:j-y-ʾ}}) collocation, which the local clause realizes directly.

topics.headline: sound repetition gives the proof closing weight
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can hear the recurring proof ending bind 98:1 and 98:4 while thickening the final word.
topics.reason: The sound observations are tied to the repeated local term and its verse-final placement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus subject is defined by having received the book, while its predicate is reciprocal scattering after the evidentiary arrival.
baseline_models.mechanism: The book-root supplies joining into a coherent whole, but the separation-root supplies dispersal of a gathered whole. The verse therefore contains an internal reversal: joined textual authority does not guarantee a joined recipient community.

activation_trace.role: Scattering a gathered whole is the literal image and supplies the community's centrifugal outcome.
Joining one thing to another is the literal image and makes the book the internal counterforce to scattering.
Granting something to someone supplies the shared act by which the subject acquired its textual identity.

changed_reading.before: The verse merely reports disagreement among people who possess scripture.
changed_reading.after: It stages a reversal in which recipients joined by a granted textual corpus become the very collective that scatters into parts.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The exclusive temporal construction locates the scattering only after the clear evidence has arrived.
baseline_models.mechanism: The evidence-root carries both disclosure and separation, while the predicate-root carries distinguishing and setting apart. Clarification can therefore expose and harden boundaries rather than automatically erase them.

activation_trace.role: Becoming visible or clear supplies the disclosure that removes informational cover.
Separation after prior connection supplies a second edge to the evidence: disclosure also marks boundaries.
Distinguishing two things turns the group's division into the social realization of a clarified difference.
Afterness supplies the one-way temporal threshold between disclosure and visible differentiation.
Concrete or abstract arrival makes the evidence an event that enters the recipients' situation.

changed_reading.before: Clear evidence should simply end disagreement.
changed_reading.after: Its arrival is the threshold at which latent differences become visible and socially distinct, so clarification may precipitate division rather than cure it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The recipients' prior passive receipt of the book is set against the later active arrival of evidence to them.
baseline_models.mechanism: Granting establishes a settled inherited possession, whereas bringing or presenting establishes a fresh encounter. The decisive change occurs when possession is converted into confrontation with a presently delivered claim.

activation_trace.role: Granting supplies the recipients' already-held status and inherited possession.
Bringing or presenting something supplies the new encounter that tests prior possession.
Temporal succession orders settled receipt before the disruptive presentation.

changed_reading.before: Possessing the book and receiving the evidence are equivalent forms of access.
changed_reading.after: The verse distinguishes inherited access from a new presentation: identity based on prior receipt is destabilized when its holders must answer a present arrival.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier non-detachment is imaged as an interlocked or closed configuration, and the same evidence marks its limit. The focus scattering then reads as one possible state released when that configuration is opened.

activation_trace.role: Dispersal into parts supplies the released configuration visible in the focus.
Afterness places that released configuration beyond the evidentiary threshold.
Opening what is closed and separating what is interlocked supplies the phase-change mechanism.
Departure, or its grammatically negated absence, supplies the held state before the limit.
Clear disclosure supplies the shared boundary event at which the held state can change.

structural_cues: 98:1 holds non-detachment under an until-boundary ending with the evidence, while 98:4 places scattering beyond the matching after-boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies interlocked opening or non-departure and the paired until/after sequence; I infer that the evidentiary arrival releases a held configuration into separation. A live alternative is that it ends one attachment without causing the later intra-group split.

changed_reading.before: The evidence merely precedes an independently arising disagreement.
changed_reading.after: The evidence functions as a phase boundary: what could not disengage before it becomes capable of opening and scattering afterward.

context_deltas.mechanism: The arrival is unfolded as an authorized messenger, sequential vocal following, written sheets, and removal of impurity. Evidence is thus a public transmission event with a person, temporal performance, material carrier, and quality control.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something lets the focus arrival receive a concrete delivery mechanism.
Disclosing meaning through speech, writing, or sign joins the performed and written channels.
Messenger and message supply the authorized human carrier of the presentation.
Following in sequence supplies recitation as an ordered unfolding rather than a static object.
A written sheet supplies the material carrier whose contents can be publicly followed.
Purity through removal of contamination supplies the carrier's asserted integrity.

structural_cues: 98:2 immediately expands the preceding evidence with a messenger, an act of recitation, and written material.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the messenger-recitation-sheets-purity sequence; I infer that this sequence specifies the delivery event that the focus says came to the recipients. The live alternative is that the evidence denotes the whole complex rather than any one component.

changed_reading.before: The evidence is an abstract proposition that recipients privately assess.
changed_reading.after: It arrives as an authorized, audible, materially carried performance, so the later division is a response to enacted communication.

context_deltas.mechanism: The contextual writings are characterized by straightness, support, and maintenance. This relocates instability away from the delivered material: content that is represented as standing and rectifying encounters holders who scatter.

activation_trace.role: Joining into a whole supplies the focus book's internal coherence.
Scattering into parts supplies the opposed behavior of the recipients.
Joined letters and written texts identify the evidence's contents as articulated writings.
Straightness and balanced uprightness supply the contents' normative alignment.
Support and sustaining structure make the writings a stabilizing framework rather than a fragmenting one.

structural_cues: 98:3 places the upright characterization inside the written sheets before 98:4 reports the recipients' scattering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies coherent writing, uprightness, support, and the following audience split; I assign instability to reception rather than to defective content. A live alternative is that the upright description marks value without making any claim about audience causation.

changed_reading.before: The split could reflect ambiguity or instability in the delivered textual material.
changed_reading.after: The material is framed as coherent and rectifying; the instability belongs to how its holders respond to a stable norm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The disclosed meaning becomes an obligation architecture: binding request, devoted obedience, purification from admixture, exclusive orientation, directional turning, and established upright practice. The evidence reorganizes allegiance and conduct, giving the split practical and social stakes.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure of intended meaning supplies the content-bearing capacity of the evidence.
Distinguishing and setting apart supplies the social result of divergent compliance.
Request carrying obligation supplies the normative force of the disclosed program.
Worship as submissive obedience supplies the program's governing relation.
Exclusive separation from partnership supplies the demanded concentration of allegiance.
Obedience and submission supply the integrated order in which the commands operate.
Inclining toward a direction supplies deliberate reorientation rather than passive assent.
Establishing straightness and balance supplies the program's durable practical form.

structural_cues: The exclusive construction in 98:5 echoes the focus exclusion while replacing temporal sequence with the content of obligation.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies commands for exclusive devotion, directional turning, and established practice; I infer that such reorganizing demands explain why disclosure can divide its recipients. The live alternative is that 98:5 states the intended norm without describing the sociology of the split.

changed_reading.before: The division concerns assent to a proposition or interpretation alone.
changed_reading.after: The evidence demands reordered allegiance and repeated practice, so division marks divergent willingness to inhabit an entire normative pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same granting-root reverses participant direction: the focus group has been given a book, while the context requires them to give an act associated with growth. Possession is tested by whether received value is turned into outward circulation.

activation_trace.role: Granting supplies the passive receipt by which the group is named in the focus.
The written book supplies the value already placed in the recipients' custody.
The repeated granting image reverses the group from recipient to active giver.
Growth and increase make the outward gift a circulation that produces increase rather than mere loss.

structural_cues: The focus uses the granting-root in a passive identity formula, and 98:5 repeats it in an active commanded form.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact root recurrence with reversed giver-recipient roles and immediately names growth; I infer a reciprocity test in which received authority must become outward action. The live alternative is that the recurrence is ordinary wording without thematic reversal.

changed_reading.before: Having been given the book is a sufficient static credential.
changed_reading.after: Received authority creates an obligation to become a giver; the split exposes whether possession becomes generative practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later contrast places concealment of truth on one side and trusted assent joined to intentional, repair-oriented action on the other, then evaluates the two within the same created field. The focus differentiation becomes response-based sorting rather than random factionalization.

activation_trace.role: Distinguishing and setting apart supplies the sorting operation in the focus.
Disclosure supplies the common criterion before responses diverge.
Covering the truth supplies one response to what has been disclosed.
Trusted assent that settles the heart supplies the opposed receptive response.
Intentional action carries assent into observable conduct.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the quality by which that conduct is evaluated.
Badness supplies the negative pole assigned to one response trajectory.
Excellence and selection supply the positive pole assigned to the other trajectory.
Creation supplies a common comparison field for the negative evaluation.
The repeated creation image holds the positive evaluation within that same field.

structural_cues: 98:6 and 98:7 repeat the same creation label while assigning opposed evaluations, and the positive side explicitly couples assent with action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposed responses, actions, and evaluations after the focus split; I infer that evidence sorts by enacted response rather than by inherited label alone. A live alternative is that the later contrast classifies outcomes without explaining the mechanism of the earlier division.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes an undifferentiated schism within a named community.
changed_reading.after: The schism resolves into a criterion-based distinction between covering disclosure and entrusting oneself to it through repair-oriented action.

context_deltas.mechanism: A focus branch images separation as a fork in a road; later recompense matches action, and repeated permanence fixes both outcome directions. Mutual acceptance on the positive side makes the divergence relational as well as spatial and temporal.

activation_trace.role: A road fork supplies the spatial model for one prior course dividing into trajectories.
Afterness gives the fork an irreversible sequence beyond the evidentiary encounter.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies consequence corresponding to trajectory.
Persistence resistant to decay fixes the negative trajectory rather than leaving it momentary.
The repeated persistence image fixes the positive trajectory with matching durability.
Long duration and continuance intensify the settled quality of the positive outcome.
Mutual acceptance supplies a reciprocal relation at the end of one trajectory.

structural_cues: The opposed populations in 98:6-7 are followed by recompense in 98:8, while persistence language occurs on both outcome sides.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a road-fork image, matching recompense, and durable endpoints; I infer that the focus split matures into path-dependent trajectories. The live alternative is that the fork is only an analogy and the outcomes do not grammatically state the split's causal continuation.

changed_reading.before: The post-evidence division is a temporary dispute at one historical moment.
changed_reading.after: It is a fork whose enacted directions acquire matching, durable outcomes and distinct final relations.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it relies on the non-dominant mapped target for the recitation root and a causative branch of the focus arrival root, while the surface verbs need not bear those senses. It remains anchored to the focus arrival and cleaving predicate and to the context delivery event; downstream prose should render it only as a pressure or toppling analogy, never as a lexical translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus directly couples an arrival with a cleaving or scattering result.

activation_trace.role: Driving or compelling supplies a possible pressure vector within the arrival inventory.
Cleaving into a separated mass supplies the visible fracture associated with that pressure.
The non-dominant split target's pouring and pushing image supplies a forceful mode for the delivery event.

changed_reading.before: Recited evidence is neutral information placed before a community.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, its delivery acts like applied pressure that forces a latent fault line to cleave.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the focus grammar presents a plural social division, whereas the cited branch concerns fear splitting the heart and the closing fear belongs to a positively evaluated figure. It remains anchored in the focus predicate and the context's fear-with-awe cue; downstream prose should preserve it as an affective echo beneath communal division, not identify the two constructions.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus separation-root includes an affective branch in which fear internally scatters the heart.

activation_trace.role: A heart split by intense fear supplies an inward analogue to the outward scattering.
Disclosure supplies the encounter capable of producing an inward as well as social response.
Fear joined with awe supplies the explicit affective cue that reactivates the focus branch.

changed_reading.before: The verse describes only an external communal schism.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the outward split may carry an inward heart-splitting response to overwhelming disclosure, with awe capable of yielding a different trajectory from panic.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses peripheral recovery branches for the focus separation-root and the later creation-root rather than the ordinary senses of the surface forms. It remains anchored to the focus split and is reinforced by contextual purification and repair images; downstream prose should frame it only as an ethical convalescence analogy in which some separation removes corruption, not as the verse's direct denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: One focus branch images recovery as an illness departing from the patient, allowing separation to be restorative rather than merely destructive.

activation_trace.role: Recovery through illness departing supplies a restorative branch of separation.
Purity through removal of contamination supplies the cleansing analogue.
Repair opposed to corruption supplies the positive function of what remains after removal.
Recovery from illness reactivates the same convalescent image at the positive evaluation.

changed_reading.before: Every post-evidence separation is simply communal decay.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, one branch of separation can be imagined as pathology leaving a body, so differentiation may expose a purified and repair-capable remainder.

strongest_changes: The context turns the evidence into a phase-transition trigger: what was held together before it can open and separate after it.
Messenger, sequential recitation, purified sheets, and upright writings make the arrival a performed and materially transmitted norm rather than abstract information.
The focus's receiver identity is tested by active giving and established practice, while later opposed evaluations sort one created field by enacted response.
The initial split can be tracked as a fork whose directions acquire matching and durable outcomes.
summary.what_was_special: The strongest latent pattern is inversion: joined writing versus scattered holders, prior non-detachment versus post-arrival release, passive receipt versus active giving, and stable content versus divergent response. Split mappings also opened pressure, inner-fear, and convalescence outliers without displacing the direct reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The evidence may denote the messenger, the recited contents, the whole delivery complex, or a wider manifest proof.
The temporal threshold strongly supports sequence, but treating the arrival as the efficient cause of division remains a reader-supplied arrow.
The non-dominant and peripheral branch outliers may remain audit-only if downstream prose cannot preserve their containment.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The proof as separator that reveals, then divides.** Evidence: ف ر ق B001 distinguishing/separating and B002 scattering into parts; ب ي ن B004 clear proof and B001 separation; ب ع د B002 afterness. Structural cue: 98:1 says release waits “until the proof comes,” but 98:4 says division happens only after it came. Assigned role: البينة both clarifies and cuts. Abductive move: I infer that disclosure can turn latent difference into explicit schism. Reading change: the ayah does not blame pre-proof confusion; it highlights post-disclosure fragmentation.

2. **Given book as a binding register whose recipients split from its demand.** Evidence: ء ت ي B002 granting/giving; ك ت ب B003 binding decree and B004 enrollment; ف ر ق B002 scattering. Structural cue: 98:3’s كتب قيّمة are inside purified sheets, and 98:5 restates a single command. Assigned role: “those given the book” are people under a received legal-textual charge. Abductive move: I supply the accountability arrow: receiving a binding book makes later division a breach of what should hold them upright. Reading change: تفرّق becomes covenantal/legal fracture, not mere communal diversity.

3. **Arrival as pressure that brings hidden accumulation to the surface.** Evidence: ج ي ء B001 coming/arrival, B002/B003 water-gathering hollow and B006 pus collection; ب ي ن B004 becoming clear. Structural cue: 98:8 later gives clean rivers; here, “came to them” precedes rupture. Assigned role: جاءتهم is the event that presses on what has accumulated unseen. Abductive move: I infer that the proof does not create corruption but exposes and drains a collected condition. Reading change: the ayah reads diagnostically: the proof’s arrival makes the wound/hollow visible by what flows out after it.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:5’s single “they were commanded only…” sharpened the surprise: after the many branches of book/proof, the demanded center is simple. 98:8’s clean flowing rivers made the darker ج ي ء water/pus variants here stand out as a contrastive, pathological flow.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Disclosure as the fork at which a latent difference becomes social division.** **Lexical evidence:** `تَفَرَّقَ` anchors `ف ر ق` B002, “dispersing and scattering into parts,” while fixed `ٱلْبَيِّنَة` anchors `ب ي ن` B004, “appearance and becoming clear,” and B001, separation. **Structural cue and role:** 98:1 holds the groups in a negated `ف ك ك` state until the proof comes; 98:4 reverses that suspension and locates scattering after the same proof’s arrival. Clarity supplies the discriminating fork, and `تَفَرَّقَ` supplies the distributed outcome. **Abductive move:** I infer that disclosure actualizes divergent responses rather than merely preceding them. **Reading change:** the division is not explained by missing evidence; it becomes a post-clarity branching event.

2. **Receiving creates an obligation to transmit outward.** **Lexical evidence:** `أُوتُوا` anchors `ء ت ي` B002, “granting and bringing,” and `ٱلْكِتَٰب` anchors `ك ت ب` B003, binding prescription. **Structural cue and role:** in the next ayah the same root appears in `يُؤْتُوا ٱلزَّكَاة`, turning recipients of a granted book into commanded givers of purifying growth. The first gift is therefore assigned the role of entrusted inflow, the second of required outflow. **Abductive move:** I infer a receive-to-give economy from root repetition; the packet does not state that the first grant causally funds the second. **Reading change:** `أُوتُوا ٱلْكِتَٰب` names responsibility as well as privilege: reception is incomplete until it becomes enacted circulation.

3. **Possession of a joining artifact does not produce a joined people.** **Lexical evidence:** fixed `ٱلْكِتَٰب` activates `ك ت ب` B001, “joining one thing to another,” directly beside fixed `تَفَرَّقَ`, `ف ر ق` B002. **Structural cue and role:** the verse places the joined object inside the very clause of social disassembly, while 98:2–98:3 have already shown plural sheets coherently containing writings. The two roots form a material-social reversal. **Abductive move:** I infer that recipients are being measured against the integrative structure of what they received. **Reading change:** the book is not background metadata; its joined form exposes the contradiction of a community that disjoins after receiving it.

4. **“After” as chronological succession becoming relational distance.** **Lexical evidence:** `بَعْد` anchors `ب ع د` B002, “afterness opposite beforeness,” and activates B001, “remoteness from nearness.” **Structural cue and role:** grammatically it orders proof before division; later 98:6–98:8 turn the resulting responses into sharply different states and relations to the Lord. The distance branch gives the temporal marker a secondary role as departure from the disclosed order. **Abductive move:** I infer moral distance from the later divergent outcomes; the fixed form itself denotes sequence, not that distance. **Reading change:** `مِن بَعْد` is heard not as a neutral timestamp alone but as the beginning of an expanding separation from what had just come near and become clear.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 98:5’s `يُؤْتُوا ٱلزَّكَاة` was the most surprising later echo: it converted fixed `أُوتُوا` (`ء ت ي` B002) from passive receipt into the first half of a receive-to-give mechanism. 98:6–98:8 then gave the small temporal word `بَعْد` a widening relational consequence: the post-proof branches arrive at opposed classifications, environments, and relations to the Lord. This later contrast corrected any treatment of the division as a merely historical timestamp.

baseline.text: Kitap verilenler ancak kendilerine açık kanıt geldikten sonra ayrılığa düştüler.

findings.text: Açıklık, eksik kanıtı gidermekten öte, gizli tutum farklarını toplumsal ayrışmaya dönüştüren bir yol ayrımı olur.
Kitabın verilmesi yalnızca ayrıcalık değil, alınanı arındırıcı bir vermeye dönüştürme sorumluluğu da doğurur.
Birleştirici yapıya sahip kitabın alınmasından sonra topluluğun dağılması, alınan metnin düzeniyle alıcıların davranışı arasında bir karşıtlık kurar.
Kitabı bağlayıcı bir yükümlülük olarak almak, kanıttan sonraki ayrılığı sıradan çeşitlilikten çıkarıp üstlenilen sorumluluğun bozulmasına dönüştürür.
Kanıttan sonra sözü, yalnızca zamanı değil, açıklanan düzenden giderek uzaklaşmayı da belirtir.
Kanıtın gelişi, önceden birikmiş bir bozukluğu basınç altında görünür kılan ve dışarı akıtan olay olarak okunabilir.

butuncul_okuma_line.raw_line: **98:4.** وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ — Birincil okuma: Kitap verilenler ancak açık delil kendilerine geldikten sonra ayrılığa düştüler. Böylece beyyine, karanlığı başlatan şey değil; gizli birikimi açığa çıkaran, ayrımı belirginleştiren ve bağlayıcı kitabın karşısında kopuşu görünür kılan kesici açıklık olur. {ف ر ق B001; ف ر ق B002; ء ت ي B002; ك ت ب B003; ك ت ب B004; ج ي ء B001; ج ي ء B003; ب ي ن B001; ب ي ن B004}
butuncul_okuma_line.arabic_text: وَمَا تَفَرَّقَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَتْهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَةُ
butuncul_okuma_line.reading_text_tr: Kitap verilenler ancak açık delil kendilerine geldikten sonra ayrılığa düştüler. Böylece beyyine, karanlığı başlatan şey değil; gizli birikimi açığa çıkaran, ayrımı belirginleştiren ve bağlayıcı kitabın karşısında kopuşu görünür kılan kesici açıklık olur.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Arriving Proof
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A messenger-borne disclosure comes into a waiting community and makes what was hidden manifest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: coming into presence `ء ت ي:B001/m01`; arrival `ج ي ء:B001/m01`; manifest proof `ب ي ن:B004/m01`; message bearer `ر س ل:B002/m01`; bringing forward `ج ي ء:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The two coming-roots supply approach and achieved arrival, while the messenger carries the disclosed content and البينة names its unveiled state. Bringing is therefore both motion toward recipients and transfer into public intelligibility.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Something remote, concealed, or merely potential crosses into presence and becomes communicable.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Arrival expands from revealed proof into route markers, answering voices, and failures of reading.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Signs, Waymarks, and Beacons
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A traveler or hearer is oriented by signs that reveal meaning, mark a route, or shine from a distance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: explanatory sign `ب ي ن:B005/m01`; identifying sign `ء م ر:B005/m01`; road waymark `ء م ر:B005/m02`; beacon `ن و ر:B005/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: بيان makes meaning legible, أمارة fixes a recognizable marker, and the beacon extends recognition across distance. The surface proof thus resonates with practical navigation: disclosure is something by which a course can be found.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Marks are joined into durable textual objects that can state, value, and bind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field moves from physical stitching to appraisal and enforceable decree.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: From Broad Sheet to Bound Codex
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A broad writable surface receives script, is joined at its edges, and becomes a collected book.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: broad surface `ص ح ف:B001/m01`; written page `ص ح ف:B002/m01`; gathered codex `ص ح ف:B003/m01`; stitching and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; inscription `ك ت ب:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The document is reconstructed materially: breadth provides the sheet, writing fills it, joining closes it, and collected sheets produce the codex. The surface books therefore retain a latent craft image of assembled textual bodies.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Marks are joined into durable textual objects that can state, value, and bind.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The same lexical field moves from physical stitching to appraisal and enforceable decree.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Decree, Upright Record, and Appraisal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A written statement acquires normative force and is assessed as straight, valuable, or authoritative.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: prescribed decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; standing value `ق و م:B010/m01`; straightness `ق و م:B008/m01`; written explanation `ب ي ن:B005/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Writing moves beyond storage into prescription. The record stands because it is both normatively straight and open to appraisal, while بيان supplies the act by which its intended meaning is set out.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Inner judgment settles into belief, guarded fear, evaluation, or contentment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Interior stance reaches learned discernment, animal skittishness, and negotiated satisfaction.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Security Held Beside Awe
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Trust establishes safety while reverent fear and alarm keep the subject alert.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: security and trust `ء م ن:B001/m01`; awe and apprehension `خ ش ي:B001/m01`; fear after separation `ف ر ق:B009/m01`; skittish aversion `ن و ر:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Security and fear are not simple opposites here. Trust supplies a stable relation, while awe, alarm, and skittish recoil regulate approach to what carries authority or danger.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Judgment and Recompense
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Conduct is judged under a written norm and answered with a corresponding outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: judgment and accounting `د ي ن:B002/m01`; recompense `ج ز ي:B001/m01`; written decree `ك ت ب:B003/m01`; adjudicative standing `ق و م:B013/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The norm is fixed, the subject stands before it, and judgment produces a matched return. This gives the surface reward an institutional grammar of decree, hearing, and result.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation is assessed and answered by recompense, payment, discharge, or a substitute.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Eschatological recompense extends into debt collection, tribute, guarantors, and proxy performance.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Tax and Tribute
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An authority levies a due, receives tribute, and marks the payer's subordinate position.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: assessed levy `ء ت ي:B008/m01`; tribute payment `ج ز ي:B004/m01`; lowered submission `ك ف ر:B014/m02`; debt obligation `د ي ن:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Giving becomes compulsory transfer: a due is assessed, collected as tribute, and embedded in a hierarchy. This is the fiscal counterpart of voluntary giving elsewhere in the surah's lexical field.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Collective life is organized through offices, records, covenants, and ranked places.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dosing and Medicinal Preparation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A remedy is prepared from food or aromatic material, purified, and placed into a child's mouth.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: oral dosing of a child `ف ك ك:B009/m01`; date-and-fenugreek remedy `ف ر ق:B012/m01`; dried medicinal meat `خ ش ي:B004/m02`; purifying medium `ط ه ر:B004/m01`; camphor `ك ف ر:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Preparation combines drying, cooking, and purification before the medicine is administered orally. The postpartum remedy and camphor broaden treatment from dosing into restorative food and aromatic material.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The field reconstructs spear assembly, patched vessels, jewelry, rendered fat, perfume grinding, and body grooming.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Stitching, Strap, Patch, and Knot
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Flexible material is stitched, strapped, patched at a weak edge, and secured by a tight knot.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: stitching and joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; cutting and shredding `ش ر ر:B004/m01`; sandal strap `ش ر ك:B004/m01`; vessel-bottom patch `ع د ن:B004/m01`; shoe extension patch `ع د ن:B004/m02`; tar-coated vessel `ع ب د:B005/m02`; tight knot `ر ب ب:B016/m02`; fringe `ش ر ر:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Joining closes a seam, strap and knot hold tension, and a patch adds material where a vessel or shoe needs reinforcement. Fringes show the loose edge that this craft work controls.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Jewelry, Necklace, and Crown
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Small joined pieces become wearable ornaments and, at the highest rank, a crown.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: earrings and bracelets `خ ل د:B003/m01`; necklace `ر س ل:B011/m02`; crown `ك ف ر:B015/m01`; joining `ك ت ب:B001/m01`; craftspeople `ع م ل:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Joining converts discrete pieces into ornaments that encircle the body. Crown extends the same fitted form into public rank, while the worker motif supplies the maker.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Fat, Ghee, Syrup, and Concentrate
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Animal or food material is rendered, clarified, and concentrated into fat, ghee, or syrup.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: rendered fat or oil `ء ه ل:B006/m01`; kidney fat `ف ر ق:B013/m01`; clarified butter `خ ل ص:B008/m01`; food residue `خ ل ص:B008/m02`; thick syrup `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; dripping roast fat `ش ر ر:B005/m01`; fragments after biting `ش ر ر:B004/m02`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Heat releases fat, clarification separates usable concentrate from residue, and continued reduction produces syrup-like thickness. The scene is a sequence of material transformation rather than a loose food list.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Agents seek advantage by hiding, trapping, shielding, competing, or coercing.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The channel includes hunter blinds, burrowing prey, shields, wrestling, and forced disobedience.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Coercion and Rebellion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Pressure forces a subject toward disobedience, and the subject may harden into opposition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: compulsion `ج ي ء:B005/m01`; coercion into disobedience `ك ف ر:B007/m01`; obstinate opposition `ع ن د:B001/m01`; enmity `ب ع د:B010/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Compulsion applies force, coerced disobedience redirects conduct, and obstinacy makes resistance durable. Enmity is the social state that remains after pressure and rebellion polarize the parties.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A course is weighed, chosen, enacted decisively, weakened by indecision, or driven to an emotional limit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Deliberation reaches penetrating judgment, total self-commitment, weak-minded compliance, futility, anger, and rebuke.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Counsel and Measured Deliberation
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A matter is approached through counsel, slow delivery, comparison, and settled resolve.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: counsel `ء م ر:B007/m01`; deliberate measured delivery `ر س ل:B004/m01`; resolve `ق و م:B003/m01`; choosing `خ ي ر:B003/m01`; workable avenue `ء ت ي:B003/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Counsel opens the question, measured delivery slows premature action, and comparison selects a workable route. Resolve is the point at which deliberation becomes commitment.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A course is weighed, chosen, enacted decisively, weakened by indecision, or driven to an emotional limit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Penetrating Judgment and Total Commitment
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A decision reaches through uncertainty and is carried out with the whole self.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: decisive effectiveness `ء ت ي:B013/m01`; penetrating judgment `ب ع د:B008/m01`; throwing one's whole self into action `ش ر ر:B007/m01`; quick execution `ع ب د:B009/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Penetration describes the cognitive cut through ambiguity, while total self-commitment and speed describe execution. The scene joins insight to irreversible action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A course is weighed, chosen, enacted decisively, weakened by indecision, or driven to an emotional limit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Weak Judgment and Divided Opinion
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A person lacks internal firmness, follows every command, and remains suspended between alternatives.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: weak-minded follower `ء م ر:B008/m01`; lax judgment `ف ك ك:B006/m01`; divided opinion `ش ر ك:B008/m01`; intermediate quality `ب ي ن:B011/m01`; bad condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Weakness prevents a judgment from cohering, divided opinion pulls in more than one direction, and the intermediate state never reaches decisive value. Compliance then comes from instability rather than conviction.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Futility, No Choice, and Strain
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Effort continues after useful options have closed and produces strain without benefit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: lack of utility `ب ع د:B009/m01`; no way or choice `ع ن د:B005/m01`; exertion and trouble `ع م ل:B007/m01`; adverse condition `ك و ن:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: No-choice closes the decision space, futility removes expected gain, and effort becomes pure strain. The adverse condition is therefore both the cause and outcome of ineffective action.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human effort is activated, organized, compensated, or voluntarily transferred as benefit.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Work expands into labor crews, stipends, thriving markets, generous gifts, and social need.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Labor Crew, Wage, and Stipend
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A crew performs assigned labor and receives recurring support for its livelihood.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: manual workers `ع م ل:B006/m01`; wage `ع م ل:B004/m01`; stipend `ج ر ي:B006/m01`; livelihood `ق و م:B009/m01`; enrolled service `ك ت ب:B004/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The crew supplies collective agency, enrollment fixes obligation, and wage or stipend sustains continued service. Livelihood is the stable outcome of repeated compensated work.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Human effort is activated, organized, compensated, or voluntarily transferred as benefit.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Willing Gift and Welfare
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A giver voluntarily presents a benefit in response to another's need.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: giving and bestowal `ء ت ي:B002/m01`; willing transfer `ر س ل:B010/m01`; generous gift `خ ي ر:B005/m01`; need `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; blessing and benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Need supplies the receiving condition, willing transfer preserves the giver's agency, and gift supplies the concrete benefit. Blessing names the surplus value by which the transfer becomes welfare rather than bare exchange.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Market, Transaction, and Demand
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Goods enter a thriving market, parties transact, and demand establishes value.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: thriving market `ق و م:B018/m01`; reciprocal dealing `ع م ل:B005/m01`; commercial partnership `ش ر ك:B001/m02`; standing appraisal `ق و م:B010/m01`; yield offered for exchange `ء ت ي:B007/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Yield supplies goods, partnership and dealing supply transaction, and demand makes the market "stand" through active exchange. Appraisal converts circulation into an articulated price or value.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Measure, Equal Weight, and Burden
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Material is placed in a known measure, compared against equal weight, and carried as a burden.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: measure and vessel `ف ر ق:B011/m01`; equal balanced weight `ق و م:B015/m01`; hanging burden `ش ر ر:B006/m02`; bodily stature as measure `ق و م:B011/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Vessel fixes volume, balanced weight fixes equivalence, and stature supplies a natural vertical measure. Burden is the same quantified material once transferred onto a carrier.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Circular form is recognized in a broad bowl, a rounded star group, and the closing edge of a month.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Concealed Thought and Derangement
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A thought settles inside the heart, remains inaccessible to others, or loses coherence when the mind is covered.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: hidden heart and thought `ج ن ن:B010/m01`; thought lodged within `خ ل د:B004/m01`; madness as covering of reason `ج ن ن:B006/m01`; weak testimony `ب ي ن:B011/m03`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Lodged thought describes durable interior content, while madness describes the loss of access to ordered reason. Weak testimony is the discourse consequence when an inward state cannot be made reliably clear.
